title: Check several messages at once
lede: Paste a handful of texts or upload screenshots, and scan them together. Each one gets the same real analysis as a single check.

screenshots.hint: Upload one or more screenshots. The text is read automatically — review and correct it below before scanning.

empty.title: Nothing scanned yet.
